controls.label: Staff controls
controls.help: Per role: the biggest discount it may give without the owner (empty = no limit) and whether it sees a customer's phone and address in full; and the end-of-day cash and bKash sheet. Nothing is limited and no sheet is asked for until you turn it on.

settings.label: Start fresh
settings.help: One time only, on go-live day: clears the test and sample business data and asks for a full backup, the words START FRESH and your PIN first. Off until you turn it on. 'Backup no older than' is how many minutes old the backup may be when it runs.

orders.label: Bulk and corporate orders
orders.help: The Orders > Bulk screen: quotes with an agreed price, advance and balance marks, a company invoice and delivery in batches. Off until you turn it on. Numbers: the advance percent a new quote starts with, how many days a quote stands, the most batches, days to the first batch and between batches, and the quote number prefix.

approvals.label: Urgent approvals on Telegram
approvals.help: Send urgent approvals (a prepaid refund, a price change, a big COD order) to your Telegram. Tap Approve or Reject, then type your PIN in the chat; the PIN message is deleted at once. Off until you turn it on. Numbers: what a big COD order is, how many minutes the buttons stay live, and the wrong-PIN alarm and lock per day.

visitors.label: Visitors (first-party analytics)
visitors.help: Counts where visitors come from, their device, the pages they open and a coarse region, on your own server. Never an IP address, a name or a phone number. Off until you turn it on. 'Keep days' is how long the daily totals are kept; 'Live now' counts people seen in the last few minutes.
